name: Na source-process kernel verification
purpose: Verify the compiled Na impact-vaporization normalization and PSD energy-density kernel, and prove that the M0 input registers the built-in impact source once while the historical MySource alias is disabled.
production_capability: Exosphere ImpactVaporization and PhotonStimulatedDesorption source kernels.
configuration: Current moon.input values: built-in impact source on, historical MySource off, total impact rate 1.69e22 s^-1, power index zero, PSD beta=0.7 and U=0.052 eV.
independent_reference: Direct source-rate and PSD formula evaluation.
units: s^-1, J at API boundary, eV inside documented PSD formula
deterministic_stochastic_controls: Deterministic rate/density kernels; distribution sampling requires a later seeded test.
procedure: Check the maintained input and generated definition for the confirmed source-selection modes, then invoke compiled production functions and compare the fixed normalization and PDF value.
acceptance_criteria: The input selects built-in impact on and MySource off; the generated user-source mode is off; both numerical values are within 1e-14 relative.
expected_pass_result: The M0 source selection contains one active impact-vaporization registration and the available Na source kernels reproduce the configured formulas.
data_hashes: none; this is formula/config verification, not source validation
status_semantics: PASS proves the M0 source-selection invariant and two kernels only; it does not prove the proposed night-to-day reservoir behavior. Full partition, thermal, sputtering, injection statistics, and budgets require I19/I29.
